023package org.opt4j.gatekeeper.extractors;
024
025import com.google.inject.Singleton;
026import org.opt4j.core.Genotype;
027import org.opt4j.core.Individual;
028import org.opt4j.core.genotype.BooleanGenotype;
029import org.opt4j.core.genotype.CompositeGenotype;
030import org.opt4j.core.genotype.DoubleGenotype;
031import org.opt4j.core.genotype.IntegerGenotype;
032import org.opt4j.gatekeeper.FeatureExtractor;
033
034import java.util.ArrayList;
035import java.util.Comparator;
036import java.util.List;
037
038@Singleton
039public class CompositeFeatureExtractor implements FeatureExtractor {
040    private int featureSize = -1;
041
042    @Override
043    public synchronized float[] extractFeatures(Individual individual) {
044        if (!(individual.getGenotype() instanceof CompositeGenotype)) {
045            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected CompositeGenotype but got " + individual.getGenotype().getClass().getSimpleName());
046        }
047
048        List<Float> featureList = new ArrayList<>();
049        flattenComposite((CompositeGenotype<?, ?>) individual.getGenotype(), featureList);
050
051        if (featureSize == -1) {
052            featureSize = featureList.size();
053        }
054
055        float[] features = new float[featureSize];
056        for (int i = 0; i < featureSize; i++) {
057            features[i] = featureList.get(i);
058        }
059        return features;
060    }
061
062    private void flattenComposite(CompositeGenotype<?, ?> composite, List<Float> featureList) {
063        // Sort keys to guarantee deterministic ordering
064        List<Object> keys = new ArrayList<>(composite.keySet());
065        keys.sort(Comparator.comparing(Object::toString));
066
067        for (Object key : keys) {
068            Genotype subGenotype = composite.get(key);
069
070            if (subGenotype instanceof CompositeGenotype) {
071                flattenComposite((CompositeGenotype<?, ?>) subGenotype, featureList);
072            } else if (subGenotype instanceof DoubleGenotype dg) {
073                for (int i = 0; i < dg.size(); i++) {                    double val = dg.get(i);
074                    double min = dg.getLowerBound(i);
075                    double max = dg.getUpperBound(i);
076                    featureList.add(max > min ? (float) ((val - min) / (max - min)) : 0.0f);
077                }
078            } else if (subGenotype instanceof IntegerGenotype ig) {
079                for (int i = 0; i < ig.size(); i++) {
080                    double val = ig.get(i);
081                    double min = ig.getLowerBound(i);
082                    double max = ig.getUpperBound(i);
083                    featureList.add(max > min ? (float) ((val - min) / (max - min)) : 0.0f);
084                }
085            } else if (subGenotype instanceof BooleanGenotype bg) {
086                for (int i = 0; i < bg.size(); i++) {
087                    featureList.add(bg.get(i) ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
088                }
089            } else if (subGenotype instanceof List) {
090                // Fallback for custom bounds-less implementations
091                for (Object element : (List<?>) subGenotype) {
092                    if (element instanceof Number) {
093                        featureList.add(((Number) element).floatValue());
094                    } else if (element instanceof Boolean) {
095                        featureList.add(((Boolean) element) ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
096                    }
097                }
098            }
099        }
100    }
101
102    @Override
103    public int getFeatureVectorSize() { return featureSize; }
104}
